prompts.spoken: Look at the shopping list. When you have it in mind, press Ready.
Pick the things that were on the list, then press Done.
All the shapes are the same but one. Pick the one that is different.
Turn up two cards at a time, and find the pairs with the same picture.
Some tiles will light up, one after another. Press Watch, then tap them in the same order.
Now tap the tiles in the same order.
Tap the circles in order, one after another. Some levels take turns between numbers and letters: one, A, two, B.
Tap the steps in the order you would do them. If a step does not belong, leave it out.
